action: Quarantine every record from18 primary-training-only DOI sources with an exact, unambiguous cross-archive discrepancy above0.3dex. Do not substitute/rescale any measured value.
selection_scope: Preselected NIST-available DOI sources occurring only in primary training. No validation/test target values or model scores determine exclusions.
reference_limit: NIST ThermoML is not critically evaluated ground truth. Quarantine expresses unresolved transcription/condition uncertainty, not proof that all records in a flagged source are wrong. Remaining sources are not universally validated.
whole_source_reason: A power-of-ten mismatch can concern a table-wide unit multiplier; retaining unmatched rows from the same uncertain source could retain the same error. Whole-source removal is conservative and its coverage cost is reported.
split_policy: Retain every surviving solute in its original identity/scaffold role; never rerandomize. Preserve global144test-solute membership and byte-identical test queries/targets.
retraining: Old experiments retained under original inputs. Refit every affected method on sourceqa version; no old/new-bank mixing.
